scoreBefore.style: A chill, reggae-infused track built on a steady, laid-back drum machine groove and a deep, melodic bassline. Clean electric guitar plays classic off-beat reggae skanks, while subtle organ pads provide harmonic texture. The male lead vocal, delivered in a relaxed and melodic French Creole, is treated with spacious reverb and delay, with layered harmonies reinforcing the chorus.
